title: Carbonation-cured cement-based products: systematic review, net-benefit framework, and reporting set — data and code
description: Search records, screening decisions, extraction records and analysis code for a PRISMA 2020 systematic review of life-cycle assessments of carbonation-cured cement-based products, together with a transparent net-benefit condition model and a proposed minimum reporting set. No effect sizes are pooled; every released value is transcribed from a primary source with its location recorded. Replaces an earlier release (10.5281/zenodo.22061901) whose effect-size dataset was unverified and has been withdrawn.
